threat_event: Business email compromise of a tax professional's mailbox through adversary-in-the-middle phishing, followed by theft of client tax documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA with number matching can be bypassed by token theft; browser email allowed from unmanaged devices; about 15% of individual source documents arrive by email
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 mailboxes; client documents; BP-03, BP-11
existing_controls: Mail filtering and lookalike-domain detection; external forwarding blocked; 24x7 SOC; inbox rule alerts
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA and device-bound sessions for all tax staff; block unmanaged-device browser access; token replay detection (POAM-001; POAM-004)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
key_risk_indicator: Share of staff on phishing-resistant MFA; BEC incidents per month; mean time to revoke sessions

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the Tax Engagement Platform and steals taxpayer data during peak filing season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (about 14,800 laptops, 64 offices); acquired-firm environments outside enterprise controls (R-003); tax workflow RTO not yet met (R-031)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-03; BP-01 to BP-06
existing_controls: EDR on 99% of endpoints; immutable backups; PAM; 24x7 SOC; annual DR test; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Integrate AF-05 and AF-06 (POAM-005); prove the 8-hour RTO (POAM-011); exercise the incident plan with the Incident Disclosure Committee (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Attacker enters through an acquired firm's legacy email tenant or network and reaches enterprise systems or client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AF-05 and AF-06 run their own tenants, tax software, and EFINs; AF-05 tenant not monitored by the SOC; local admin rights
affected_asset_or_process: AF-05 and AF-06 environments; BP-17; enterprise network
existing_controls: Site-to-site links restricted to named hosts; EDR at AF-06 only
treatment_plan: Migrate AF-05 by 2026-12-15 and AF-06 by 2027-03-31 to the enterprise tenant, identity platform, and tax platform (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: AF users federated; AF mailboxes monitored; AF EFINs retired

threat_event: Refund diversion: an attacker posing as a client, or using a hijacked mailbox, gets a direct deposit account changed on a return before e-file
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes requested by email are verified by call-back at enterprise offices but not consistently at AF-05 and AF-06; no alert on bank changes after review
existing_controls: Call-back rule for bank changes (POL-05); alert on bank changes after reviewer approval; reviewer checklist
treatment_plan: Extend call-back to AF-05 and AF-06; require step-up authentication for portal bank changes; refund diversion training for reviewers (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Bank changes after review; call-back completion rate; client fraud complaints

threat_event: The e-file transmitter is down for more than 8 hours in the week before a filing deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One transmitter carries 100% of e-files; contract RTO 12 h; no tested alternative (P05 DEP-01)
existing_controls: Vendor redundant data centers; vendor status page; early-extension procedure
treatment_plan: Contract amendment for an 8-hour RTO; tested early-extension plan before each deadline; evaluate a second transmission path by 2027-09-01 (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Transmitter availability in peak; returns waiting in queue; extension readiness

threat_event: Client portal accounts are taken over by credential stuffing and used to download returns and source documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for individual clients (64% enrolled); reused passwords common
existing_controls: Progressive delays; breached-password checks; bot detection at the WAF
treatment_plan: Mandatory MFA for all client accounts before the 2027 season; disable accounts inactive 24 months (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Client MFA enrollment; credential stuffing attempts blocked; account takeover reports

threat_event: An employee or seasonal worker browses or exports returns beyond need-to-know (for example, high-profile clients)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31% of DMS tax repositories open to whole office teams; bulk export alerts not tuned by role
existing_controls: Engagement roles in the tax application; confidentiality agreement; sanctions
treatment_plan: Engagement-based DMS permissions; role-tuned bulk export and atypical access models (POAM-003; POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Share of repositories on engagement permissions; atypical access alerts

threat_event: Tax return information is disclosed to the offshore provider without prior consent, or Form 1040 filers' SSNs reach it unmasked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consent check is manual for business returns; masking misses partner SSNs on attached Schedules K-1
existing_controls: Consent template; masking script; virtual desktops with copy and print blocked
treatment_plan: Automated consent gate before release; masking of K-1 attachments; monthly sample (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: Packages released without consent; unmasked SSNs found in sampling

threat_event: Stolen session tokens are replayed for days without detection, giving persistent access to mail and the DMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No token replay detection; risky sign-in rules tuned for passwords, not tokens
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; impossible travel alerts; inbox rule alerts
treatment_plan: Token replay and device-binding detections; continuous access evaluation for email and DMS (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Mean time to detect token replay in purple-team tests

threat_event: Seasonal staff keep access after the season and misuse it, or their accounts are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: End dates not always entered; 4 of 60 sampled seasonal terminations disabled 2 to 9 business days late
existing_controls: Identity governance termination workflow; account expiry for most seasonal hires
treatment_plan: Mandatory end dates at hire; automated disablement at season end (POAM-006)
key_risk_indicator: Seasonal accounts active after end date

threat_event: Former clients' records kept beyond need enlarge the impact of any breach and miss the disposal rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disposal run; about 2.1 million former-client records past the 7-year schedule
existing_controls: Records schedule exists; legal hold process
treatment_plan: First disposal run after the October deadline, with legal hold checks and a disposal log (POAM-007)
key_risk_indicator: Records past schedule; disposal runs completed

threat_event: Staff put client SSNs or account numbers into prompts of the approved enterprise AI assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prompt rules rely on training; data loss prevention does not yet inspect AI prompts
existing_controls: Enterprise terms: U.S. processing, no training; prompt rules in POL-05
treatment_plan: Data loss prevention rule for AI prompts; quarterly prompt sampling (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Prompts with SSNs found in sampling

threat_event: AI extraction errors put wrong figures on returns, with higher error rates for some client groups (photographed or handwritten documents)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Extraction accuracy below threshold on photographed documents; bias testing incomplete
existing_controls: Reviewer checks of AI-populated fields; confidence scores
treatment_plan: Group-level error testing each month in season; mandatory verification of low-confidence fields (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Field error rate by document type and client group

threat_event: AI use cases run without committee review or a documented IRC 7216 basis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 12 use cases unreviewed; 7216 basis documented for 5 of 9 that touch tax return information
existing_controls: AI governance committee; intake form
treatment_plan: Complete reviews and 7216 memos for all use cases by 2027-01-08 (POAM-020)

threat_event: AF-05 or AF-06 cannot restore their tax or file servers after an incident in season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backups only; restores never tested
existing_controls: MSP backups
treatment_plan: Restore test at AF-06 by 2026-11-30; migrate data to the enterprise platform (POAM-005)

threat_event: Notices to the FTC, IRS, states, and clients are late or wrong because the business email compromise playbook has never been exercised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook untested; Incident Disclosure Committee has 3 new members since 2025; three clocks (discovery, confirmation, determination) easily confused
existing_controls: Written incident response plan; outside counsel retained
treatment_plan: Tabletop with the Incident Disclosure Committee on 2026-11-19; playbook update (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Exercise completed; notices sent within deadline in exercises

threat_event: SEC-registrant clients are told late about an incident affecting their data, so their own materiality assessments are delayed and contracts are breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client contract notice terms vary from 24 to 72 hours and are not tracked centrally
affected_asset_or_process: Client contracts; SL-1; SL-2; issuer audit clients
regulatory_driver: Client contracts; SEC Release 33-11216 (registrants' duties for incidents on third-party systems)
existing_controls: Account teams hold contracts; General Counsel reviews major contracts
treatment_plan: Central register of client notice terms; client-notice step in the playbook (POAM-023; POAM-010)

threat_event: Multistate breach notices miss state-specific deadlines or content because the state law matrix is out of date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix last updated 2024-11
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: Outside counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: Counsel updates the state matrix and sets an annual refresh (POAM-023)

threat_event: The IRS next-business-day security incident report is missed because responsibility across 30 EFINs is unclear
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Responsible Officials differ by EFIN; AF-05 and AF-06 not in the enterprise process
existing_controls: Director of e-file Operations named as single point of contact
treatment_plan: EFIN-to-Responsible Official map in the runbook; include AF EFINs (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Time from confirmation to IRS report in exercises

threat_event: IRS e-Services credentials of a Responsible Official are stolen and used to view or change EFIN data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Responsible Officials' e-Services credentials tied to personal email at 2 EFINs
existing_controls: IRS-required identity verification for e-Services; weekly EFIN volume check
treatment_plan: Move all e-Services accounts to firm email; weekly EFIN and PTIN volume review in season
key_risk_indicator: Returns filed per EFIN against firm counts

threat_event: A cloud administrator account is compromised and used to change infrastructure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Few privileged accounts; strong controls
existing_controls: PAM with just-in-time elevation; FIDO2 keys; session recording
treatment_plan: Accepted at Moderate by the CISO with the CIO; review annually

threat_event: Loss or mismanagement of customer-managed encryption keys makes tax data unrecoverable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys rotated automatically; deletion protection on
existing_controls: Deletion protection; key backups
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the risk owner with GRC concurrence

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes the client portal down near a filing deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portal
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; edge protections in place

threat_event: Password spraying against workforce sign-in
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large user base; MFA required for all users
existing_controls: Lockout; breached-password list; MFA
treatment_plan: Retire legacy authentication exceptions on 9 service mailboxes (POAM-001)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Vendor payment fraud: a fake vendor email changes the firm's payee bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts payable verifies changes by call-back, but the rule is not system-enforced
existing_controls: Call-back rule; dual approval for payee changes
treatment_plan: System hold on payee bank changes until call-back is recorded

threat_event: SL-1 payroll diversion: a fake request changes a client employee's direct deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client employees request changes through client administrators by email
existing_controls: Call-back to client administrator; change hold for 2 pay cycles on new accounts
treatment_plan: Self-service changes only through the employee portal with MFA; alert on changes before payday
key_risk_indicator: Direct deposit changes within 3 days of payday

threat_event: An untested change to tax application rules (e-file or direct deposit fields) produces wrong returns at scale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 40 sampled changes lacked documented testing (P07 CM-3)
existing_controls: Change advisory board; release freeze near deadlines
treatment_plan: Enforce test evidence before approval in the change tool (POAM-009)

threat_event: Client documents received by email build up in mailboxes and are exposed in any mailbox compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 15% of individual source documents arrive by email; no auto-move to the DMS
existing_controls: Portal-first messaging to clients
treatment_plan: Auto-file email attachments to the DMS and purge from mailboxes after 30 days; client portal campaign
key_risk_indicator: Share of documents received by email

threat_event: A laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All laptops encrypted and remotely wipeable
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; encryption makes the data unusable

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted tax software or vendor update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tax software updates install across the platform quickly in season
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 review; integrity checks
treatment_plan: Staged rollout of tier-1 software updates; software bill of materials from tier-1 vendors

threat_event: The tax workflow and e-file queue take longer than 8 hours to recover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9.5 h recovery in the 2026-05-09 DR test
existing_controls: Warm standby; runbooks
treatment_plan: Automate queue recovery; retest by 2027-01-08 (POAM-011)

threat_event: A cloud region outage in peak season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region
existing_controls: Standby region; tested failover
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; covered by standby

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida offices and DC-1 during the September and October extension season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 Florida offices; DC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: Remote work; DC-2 replica; IRS disaster relief postponements when declared
treatment_plan: Pre-season hurricane readiness check for Florida offices each August

threat_event: Dormant client portal accounts are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 41,000 accounts inactive more than 24 months still enabled
existing_controls: Breached-password checks
treatment_plan: Disable accounts inactive 24 months (POAM-002)

threat_event: Orphaned service or privileged accounts in the tax application are misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 orphaned service accounts; 2 of 12 privileged group certifications missed
existing_controls: PAM; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Remove orphaned accounts; enforce certification completion (POAM-018)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: An unpatched client portal component is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 60 sampled critical and high findings past the 15-day target
existing_controls: Monthly authenticated scans; WAF
treatment_plan: Clear the backlog; automate container rebuilds (POAM-013)

threat_event: The e-signature identity verification service fails in peak season or is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single service; no SOC report reviewed; no tested fallback besides wet signatures
existing_controls: Wet-signature fallback
treatment_plan: Obtain and review the vendor's assurance report; test the fallback before the season (POAM-015)

threat_event: A third party holding client data (tier 1 or 2) suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 260 vendors with client data; 9 of 31 TEP vendors overdue for review
existing_controls: Tiered reviews; contract terms; SOC report reviews
treatment_plan: Clear overdue reviews; continuous monitoring of tier-1 vendors (POAM-015)

threat_event: The offshore provider's own network is compromised and attackers watch virtual desktop sessions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider endpoints outside firm control
existing_controls: Copy and print blocked; registered network only; provider SOC 2 reviewed
treatment_plan: Session watermarking and screen capture blocking on virtual desktops

threat_event: PHI in audit workpapers or consulting data rooms is breached, triggering notice to health care clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No separate HIPAA risk analysis for business associate data; PHI not tagged in the DMS
existing_controls: Encryption; access logging; business associate agreements
treatment_plan: Business associate risk analysis; PHI tagging; legacy agreement update (POAM-021)

threat_event: Staff paste client data into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public AI sites reachable from firm devices until 2026-08
existing_controls: Public AI domains blocked at the web gateway since 2026-08-10; approved tools list
treatment_plan: Blocked; approved enterprise assistant offered instead

threat_event: Federal Contract Information is mishandled or a subcontract lacks the FAR flow-down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI not tagged; 4 of 19 subcontracts lack the clause
existing_controls: Contract review by the Office of General Counsel
treatment_plan: Tag FCI repositories; amend subcontracts (POAM-022)

threat_event: An AI drafting feature makes substantive tax determinations from client data without consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor offered AI drafting suggestions
existing_controls: Feature disabled 2026-08-25
treatment_plan: Feature stays off unless the AI governance committee approves a consent design

threat_event: An offshore provider employee photographs returns on screen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider staff work in a secured delivery center
existing_controls: Clean-desk delivery floor with no phones (contract); masked SSNs
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the National Tax Leader with GRC concurrence

threat_event: Service organization clients' evidence collected in SOC examinations is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Evidence stored in the audit platform with engagement permissions
existing_controls: Engagement permissions; encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: The SL-1 SOC 2 report carries an exception because access removal is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prior report exception (2025); seasonal process weaknesses
regulatory_driver: SL-1 client contracts; AICPA Trust Services Criteria
existing_controls: Remediated access removal for SL-1 staff
treatment_plan: Monthly access removal checks for SL-1

threat_event: SL-2 is not ready for its first SOC 2 Type 2 and corporate clients leave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SL-2 has partially ready criteria (P09)
existing_controls: Readiness program
treatment_plan: Close SL-2 readiness gaps by 2027-03-31 (P09)

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing edge device at AF-05 or AF-06 is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy firewalls and VPNs at acquired firms, outside enterprise patch management
existing_controls: MSP patching
treatment_plan: Retire legacy edge devices with SD-WAN migration (POAM-005); emergency patch target 72 h

threat_event: Seasonal staff click phishing links and give up credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Seasonal phishing click rate 9.8% against 3.1% firm-wide
existing_controls: Monthly phishing simulations; report-phish button
treatment_plan: Training before access; targeted coaching for seasonal staff (POAM-006; POAM-014)

threat_event: Attackers delete or encrypt backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Immutable backup accounts
existing_controls: Immutability locks; separate accounts; offline copies at DC-2
treatment_plan: Accepted at Moderate by the CISO with the CIO; immutability tested quarterly

threat_event: Logs from AF-05 and AF-06 are missing when an incident must be investigated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AF-05 tenant not in the SIEM; AF-06 local logs kept 30 days
existing_controls: AF-06 EDR
treatment_plan: Interim log export to the SIEM; migration (POAM-005)

threat_event: Data leaks from managed mobile devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Managed apps with app protection policies
existing_controls: App protection policies
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: The data lake keeps unmasked SSNs that analysts do not need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Masked views exist but raw tables keep SSNs for 7 years
existing_controls: Masked analyst views; named engineer access
treatment_plan: Tokenize SSNs in raw tables

threat_event: The legacy archive at DC-1 (2004 to 2014 files) is accessed with shared administrator accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy archive uses two shared admin accounts in PAM
existing_controls: Accounts vaulted in PAM with session recording
treatment_plan: Dispose of archive contents past schedule (POAM-007); named admin accounts

threat_event: A change to IRS e-file rules or the Safeguards Rule is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Regulatory watch by the Office of General Counsel
existing_controls: Monthly regulatory watch
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: A return is emailed to the wrong client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email autocomplete; portal-first rule not always followed
existing_controls: Data loss prevention warning on external email with SSNs
treatment_plan: Block external email with returns attached; portal delivery only

threat_event: A payroll engine processing error pays SL-1 client employees wrongly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex client rules
existing_controls: Pre-payroll variance checks
treatment_plan: Automated variance thresholds per client

threat_event: A deepfake voice call impersonating a partner authorizes a bank change or data release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Voice-only approvals still accepted in some offices
existing_controls: Call-back rule
treatment_plan: No voice-only approvals; call-back to a number on file

threat_event: The legacy SL-2 file transfer endpoint is attacked through outdated cipher suites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Endpoint used by 12 corporate clients
existing_controls: IP allow lists
treatment_plan: Retire the endpoint (POAM-016)

threat_event: An incident at AF-05 or AF-06 is not reported to the SOC or the IRS in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate MSP processes at the acquired firms
existing_controls: Interim escalation list
treatment_plan: Bring AF incidents into the SOC process (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: AF incidents logged by the SOC

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without security due diligence and integration funding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Six acquisitions in 2024-2026; due diligence uneven
existing_controls: POL-01 statement on acquisitions (new)
treatment_plan: Security due diligence and funded integration plan required before closing (POL-01 4.10)

threat_event: The e-file program depends on a few Responsible Officials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups named for each EFIN
existing_controls: Backup Responsible Officials
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes storage to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Preventive guardrails block public storage
existing_controls: Guardrails; daily posture scans
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Attackers use default administrator passwords on processing hub printer-scanners to read scans or send mail that looks internal (found in P07 testing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 60 sampled devices had default administrator passwords; scan-to-email accounts store passwords on the device
existing_controls: Devices on office networks behind firewalls
treatment_plan: Change all device passwords; replace stored scan-to-email passwords with relay restrictions (POAM-012)
